items.zh: 明天的考试你复习到哪儿了？
items.scene: 下班后，你问一起备考的同事

answers.en: How far have you gotten with your review for tomorrow's test?
answers.note: 问复习进度，默认还没结束，语气中性，适合下班路上随口了解进展。

answers.en: Have you finished going over everything for tomorrow?
answers.note: 问有没有全部看完，回答基本是或否，比问进度更像考前确认。

answers.en: Do you feel ready for tomorrow's test?
answers.note: 问心里有没有底，不关心看了多少，适合不想给对方压力的闲聊。

items.zh: 这次考试是开卷还是闭卷？
items.scene: 考前一周，你在群里问课程助教

answers.en: Is the test open-book or closed-book?
answers.note: 直接问考试形式，用开卷、闭卷的标准说法，信息最清楚，适合群里问助教。

answers.en: Are we allowed to bring our notes into the test?
answers.note: 不问名称，只问能不能带资料，关注实际规则，适合担心术语说不清。

answers.en: Do we get to use our books during the test, or is it closed-book?
answers.note: Do we get to 带点期待，确认能不能翻书，语气随意，适合同学间互通消息。

items.zh: 考试能带计算器进去吗？
items.scene: 进考场前，你问监考老师

answers.en: Are calculators allowed in the exam?
answers.note: 用被动句问规定，不突出个人，语气正式，适合问监考老师。

answers.en: Can I bring a calculator into the test?
answers.note: 直接问自己能不能带，重点在个人许可，适合进考场前确认。

answers.en: Is it okay if I use a calculator during the test?
answers.note: Is it okay if 开头，口气偏软，像临时问个小问题，适合已经坐下时。

items.zh: 你复习了一晚上，重点都记住了吗？
items.scene: 室友合上书，你递给他一杯水

answers.en: You've been studying all evening — did you get the key points down?
answers.note: 先点出对方学了一整晚，再问重点有没有掌握，语气像室友关心，适合睡前随口聊。

answers.en: After a whole night of review, do you feel like the main points stuck?
answers.note: 用 stuck 问知识点有没有留在脑子里，关注记忆效果，适合第二天还要接着考时。

answers.en: Did you manage to memorize all the important stuff?
answers.note: 直接问有没有把重点背下来，聚焦硬记的内容，适合这门课主要靠背诵时。

items.zh: 这章太难了，你一般怎么复习？
items.scene: 自习室里，你向同学请教方法

answers.en: This chapter is really tough. How do you usually review it?
answers.note: 先陈述难，再问常规做法，语气平稳，适合刚认识的同学之间讨教。

answers.en: I'm stuck on this chapter — what's your approach?
answers.note: 用 stuck 说明自己卡住了，重点问对方的思路，比问步骤更像交流方法。

answers.en: This chapter is kicking my butt. How do you get through it?
answers.note: kicking my butt 带自嘲和夸张，适合熟人之间抱怨后再问怎么熬过去。

items.zh: 我一看书就想刷手机，怎么才能进入复习状态？
items.scene: 午休时，你跟同事吐槽自己静不下心

answers.en: Every time I open a book, I end up scrolling on my phone. How do I get into study mode?
answers.note: 用 end up 说明不知不觉就刷起手机，重点问怎么切换状态，像朋友间吐槽。

answers.en: I find it hard to concentrate when I study. Do you have any suggestions?
answers.note: 用 I find it hard to 陈述困难，再客气地要建议，语气偏正式，适合不太熟的同事。

answers.en: The second I sit down to study, I'm on my phone. How do you make yourself focus?
answers.note: The second 强调一坐下就发生，问对方个人怎么管住自己，适合熟人之间取经。

items.zh: 这个考试报名截止到几号？
items.scene: 你在公司培训群里问负责报名的同事

answers.en: When's the registration deadline for this exam?
answers.note: 用缩略形式直接问截止日期，办公室群里常用，语气自然，不像正式通知。

answers.en: What's the last day to sign up for the test?
answers.note: 换成 last day to sign up，避开报名术语，问法直白，适合随口确认。

answers.en: Could you tell me when registration closes?
answers.note: 用 Could you tell me 间接提问，礼貌偏正式，适合问不熟的负责人或发邮件。

items.zh: 报名费能开发票吗？
items.scene: 你准备报名，向前台确认报销材料

answers.en: Can I get an invoice for the registration fee?
answers.note: 直接问能不能开发票，invoice 正对报销场景，句子短，适合微信问对接人。

answers.en: Will there be a receipt I can use for reimbursement?
answers.note: receipt 是收据，先确认有没有报销凭证；国内通常还要发票，别把两者当成一样。

answers.en: Do you provide invoices for the exam fee? I need one for my company.
answers.note: 先问是否提供发票，再说明公司报销，信息完整，语气正式，适合发邮件。

items.zh: 我错过了报名时间，还能补报吗？
items.scene: 报名系统关了，你打电话问考试中心

answers.en: I missed the registration deadline. Is late registration still possible?
answers.note: 用 late registration 这个固定说法问补报，陈述在前，语气正式，适合打考试中心电话。

answers.en: I missed the sign-up window — can I still get in?
answers.note: sign-up window 指报名时段，get in 指还能不能报上，口语随意，适合和工作人员熟一点。

answers.en: Is there any way I can still register, even though the deadline has passed?
answers.note: 把截止时间已过讲清楚，再委婉问有没有办法，语气客气，适合求通融。

items.zh: 成绩什么时候出？
items.scene: 考完一周，你在班级群里问老师

answers.en: When will the results come out?
answers.note: 直接问成绩公布时间，results come out 中性通用，适合问老师或教务。

answers.en: Do you know when we'll get our scores?
answers.note: 先问老师知不知道，给对方留余地，语气客气，适合不想显得催。

answers.en: Any idea when grades are posted?
answers.note: Any idea 开头很随意，grades are posted 指成绩挂到系统上，适合群里问。

items.zh: 你查成绩了吗？过了没？
items.scene: 出分当天，你在微信上问一起考试的朋友

answers.en: Did you check your score? Did you pass?
answers.note: 两个短问句连着问，先查没查再过没过，节奏直接，适合关系近的朋友。

answers.en: Have you seen your results yet? How'd it go?
answers.note: How'd it go 不逼对方说过没过，给没考好的人留台阶，适合不确定结果时。

answers.en: So, did you pass?
answers.note: 省掉查分那一问，默认对方已经知道，语气轻松，适合平时常互损的朋友。

items.zh: 我差两分没过，能申请复核成绩吗？
items.scene: 你拿着成绩单，打电话问考试办公室

answers.en: I missed the passing score by two points. Can I request a score review?
answers.note: 用 missed ... by two points 说差两分，再正式申请复核，适合电话或邮件。

answers.en: I was two points short. Is there a way to get my exam regraded?
answers.note: two points short 更简短，regraded 指重新评分，问法直接，适合熟悉的教务人员。

answers.en: I failed by just two points — can someone take another look at my answers?
answers.note: failed by just two points 带明显不甘心，再请求人工再看，适合当面沟通。

items.zh: 这个证书对找工作有用吗？
items.scene: 你刷到培训广告，转头问身边的前辈

answers.en: Is this certificate actually useful for job hunting?
answers.note: actually 带怀疑，像在确认广告有没有夸大，适合问有经验的朋友。

answers.en: Does this certification help when you're applying for jobs?
answers.note: 用 certification 和 applying for jobs，问得务实，适合正式打听含金量。

answers.en: Do employers around here care about this certificate?
answers.note: 把重点放在本地用人单位在不在乎，口气随意，适合问行业里的前辈。

items.zh: 证书上的名字写错了，能改吗？
items.scene: 你打开刚寄到的证书，打电话问发证机构

answers.en: My name is misspelled on the certificate. Can it be corrected?
answers.note: 用 misspelled 和被动句，先陈述错误再问能否更正，语气正式，适合对外联系。

answers.en: There's a typo in my name on the certificate — can you fix it?
answers.note: typo 指打字错误，fix it 直接，适合和客服快速说明，不绕弯。

answers.en: My name came out wrong on the certificate. Is there any way to get a new one?
answers.note: came out wrong 偏口语，重点问能不能换新证，适合对方态度好时商量。

items.zh: 网课卡得厉害，你那边也这样吗？
items.scene: 直播课一直转圈，你在课程群里问同学

answers.en: The online class keeps freezing. Is it the same on your end?
answers.note: 用 freezing 说画面卡住，再问对方那边是否一样，适合在课程群里确认。

answers.en: My video keeps buffering — is yours doing that too?
answers.note: buffering 指缓冲转圈，yours doing that too 很口语，适合同学间快速对情况。

answers.en: Is anyone else's stream lagging this badly?
answers.note: 直接问还有谁的直播也卡成这样，把问题抛给全群，适合找同伴确认。

items.zh: 这节网课有回放吗？
items.scene: 你加班错过直播，私信问课程老师

answers.en: Will this class be recorded?
answers.note: 问这节课会不会录，没假设回放已经存在，语气中性，适合课前课后问老师。

answers.en: Is there a replay of today's online class?
answers.note: 直接问有没有回放，replay 指录播，适合确认资源是否已经上传。

answers.en: I missed the live session — can I watch it later?
answers.note: 先说明错过直播，再问能不能补看，信息完整，适合请老师帮忙。

items.zh: 网课作业在哪儿交？
items.scene: 第一次上完网课，你在群里问助教

answers.en: Where do I submit the assignment for this online class?
answers.note: 用 submit 和 assignment，偏书面，适合问助教或查课程说明。

answers.en: Where are we supposed to turn in the homework?
answers.note: turn in 是美式口语，be supposed to 问规定，适合同学群里问。

answers.en: Is the homework uploaded somewhere, or do we email it to you?
answers.note: 把上传和邮件两种可能都问出来，省得来回确认，适合规则没说清时。

items.zh: 图书馆周末几点关门？
items.scene: 你周六来自习，进门时问前台

answers.en: What time does the library close on the weekend?
answers.note: 直接问周末几点关门，最通用，适合不清楚周六周日是否一样时。

answers.en: How late is the library open on Saturdays?
answers.note: 把范围缩到周六，问开到多晚，适合只关心当天能待多久。

answers.en: Is the library open normal hours this weekend?
answers.note: 先确认周末是不是照常开放，适合节假日前后，免得白跑。

items.zh: 这本书被借走了，能预约吗？
items.scene: 你在图书馆系统里查到书已借出

answers.en: This book is checked out. Can I place a hold on it?
answers.note: checked out 和 place a hold 都是图书馆常用说法，简洁专业，适合问馆员。

answers.en: Someone's already borrowed this book — can I get on the waitlist?
answers.note: waitlist 指排队等书，说法口语，适合不想用专业词时。

answers.en: Is it possible to reserve this book for when it comes back?
answers.note: 用 reserve 并说明等书还回来，意思完整，语气客气，适合正式询问。

items.zh: 上节课的笔记能借我拍一下吗？
items.scene: 你缺了一节课，课间问同桌

answers.en: Could I take a quick photo of your notes from last class?
answers.note: Could I 开头礼貌，说明只快速拍一下，适合不太熟的同学。

answers.en: Can I snap your notes from last time? I missed class.
answers.note: snap 是拍照的口语说法，补上缺课理由，语气随意，适合熟人。

answers.en: I missed last class — would you mind sharing your notes with me?
answers.note: 先说明缺课，再用 would you mind 请求分享，口气最客气，适合关系一般时。

items.zh: 你笔记记得好全，用什么软件整理的？
items.scene: 小组讨论后，你看到同学的笔记很整齐

answers.en: Your notes are so thorough — what app do you use to organize them?
answers.note: 先夸笔记记得全，再问用什么应用，顺序自然，适合刚一起上完课。

answers.en: What software do you use for your notes? They're incredibly well organized.
answers.note: 先问软件再补一句夸奖，重点在工具，适合只想快点问到结果。

answers.en: I love how organized your notes are. Do you mind sharing what you use?
answers.note: 用 I love how 开头，再问能不能分享，语气最客气，适合不太熟的人。

items.zh: 这门课我挂了，补考一般安排在什么时候？
items.scene: 你收到成绩，问同专业的学长

answers.en: I failed the course. When is the retake usually scheduled?
answers.note: 直接用 failed 和 retake，问得正式清楚，适合问教务或学长确认安排。

answers.en: I didn't pass the class — when do retakes normally happen?
answers.note: 用 didn't pass 代替 failed，语气缓一些，适合不想把话说得太重时。

answers.en: So I flunked. When's the make-up exam usually?
answers.note: flunked 很口语，带自嘲，make-up exam 指补考，适合跟熟人吐槽着问。

items.zh: 补考再不过我是不是要重修？
items.scene: 你担心补考还过不了，问辅导员

answers.en: If I don't pass the make-up exam, will I have to repeat the course?
answers.note: 用条件句把最坏情况问清楚，repeat the course 指重修，语气正式，适合问辅导员。

answers.en: What happens if I flunk the retake too — do I have to take the class again?
answers.note: flunk the retake too 带口语和一点自嘲，先问会怎样再问要不要重上，适合熟人。

answers.en: Am I looking at repeating the course if the make-up exam doesn't go well?
answers.note: be looking at 表示可能面对的结果，语气担心，适合委婉确认后果。

items.zh: 我想三个月内考过，学习计划该怎么排？
items.scene: 你刚报名，向前辈请教备考安排

answers.en: I want to pass in three months. How should I structure my study plan?
answers.note: 用 structure 问怎么搭框架，语气认真，适合请有经验的人给整体建议。

answers.en: I've got three months to pass — how would you split up the studying?
answers.note: split up the studying 指把学习内容拆开安排，口语自然，适合熟人讨论。

answers.en: What's a realistic study schedule if I want to pass in three months?
answers.note: realistic 强调计划要能执行，不只排得满，适合担心坚持不下来时。

items.zh: 我计划每天学一小时，可一加班就断了，怎么坚持？
items.scene: 你跟朋友聊起自己总坚持不下去

answers.en: I plan to study an hour a day, but overtime throws me off. How do you stay consistent?
answers.note: 用 throws me off 说加班打乱节奏，再问对方怎么保持，语气平和，适合朋友间讨论。

answers.en: Every time I work late, my study plan falls apart. How do I keep it going?
answers.note: Every time 强调反复发生，falls apart 说计划垮掉，口语感强，适合吐槽。

answers.en: I set aside an hour a day, but one late night at work and the whole plan collapses. Any advice?
answers.note: one late night ... and ... collapses 有夸张画面，语气无奈，适合熟人求建议。
